items.spoken_hook: Top K Frequent Elements: sorting के बिना O(n) में!
items.hook_source: Plain payoff form, same as d009
items.one_idea: Top K Frequent Elements: count every value with a hash map, then use the count itself as a bucket index so the top k come out in O(n) without sorting.
items.visual_idea: The array row feeds a count table (value: count); then a row of buckets indexed 1 to 10 where each value drops into the bucket numbered by its count, and a pointer walks the buckets from 10 down to 1 until k=2 are picked; actual Python code visible in readable chunks synced to the voice.
facts_to_verify: Problem paraphrased from doocs mirror of LeetCode 347. Heap O(n log k) per doocs. Bucket O(n) time and O(n) extra space is our own derived analysis. Code was run: [4, 1] (qa/d016/run_output.txt). 1.7 million vs n log n is EXAMPLE arithmetic.
